facts: _locking starts at the current file offset for the requested byte count and permits locking past end of file.
LK_LOCK retains its documented one-second retry interval and ten-attempt limit; LK_NBLCK reports failure immediately when the bytes cannot be locked.
_chsize_s documents EACCES when the file is locked against access.

limit: These API contracts motivate the isolated overlap control. They do not prove that the exact equal-size ftruncate operation fails on the retained Windows runner, and do not establish the historical journal event cause. No product repair follows before actual evidence.
